A small Node.js HTTP/JSON service for managing a vehicle fleet: register vehicles, list them, flag maintenance, look up last GPS position, and export a monthly report. No authentication, no UI.

| Variable | Purpose | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `PORT` | HTTP listen port | 3000 |

- Returns 200 with a JSON array of all vehicles.

- Body is JSON. `plate` is required; if missing → 400 `{"error":"plate required"}`.

### FR-5 Monthly report — `GET /reports/monthly`
- Returns 200 `{ "rows": [all vehicles], "format": "v1" }`.

- Any other method/path → 404 `{"error":"no route"}`.

- Storage is in-memory only; `DATABASE_URL` is read and exposed but never used to persist data. Data is lost on restart.

A small Node.js HTTP/JSON service for managing a vehicle fleet: register vehicles, list them, flag maintenance, look up last GPS position, and export a monthly report. No authentication, no UI.

## 2. Configuration
| Variable | Purpose | Default |
|---|---|---|

### FR-1 List vehicles — `GET /vehicles`
- Returns 200 with a JSON array of all vehicles.

### FR-2 Register vehicle — `POST /vehicles`
- Body is JSON. `plate` is required; if missing → 400 `{"error":"plate required"}`.
- On success → 201 with the stored vehicle: all submitted fields, plus `status: "active"` (any client-supplied `status` is overridden) and a generated `id`.
- IDs are sequential strings ("1", "2", …).

### FR-3 Maintenance check — `POST /vehicles/:id/maintenance`
- If the vehicle's `mileage` > 20000, status becomes `maintenance-due`.
- Otherwise the vehicle is unchanged. Always returns 200 with the vehicle.
- No way to clear `maintenance-due` exists.
- Mileage is client-supplied at registration; there is no endpoint to update it.

### FR-4 Last known position — `GET /vehicles/:id/position`
- Proxies to `${TELEMATICS_URL}/v2/devices/:id/position` using an authorization header, and returns the provider's JSON body with 200.
- The vehicle id is used directly as the telematics device id.

### FR-5 Monthly report — `GET /reports/monthly`
- Returns 200 `{ "rows": [all vehicles], "format": "v1" }`.

- Any other method/path → 404 `{"error":"no route"}`.
